paired_primary_development_observation.interpretation: Both favorable error discordances are explanatory-relation errors, but D retains one earlier false abstention and omits one available planning-mechanism unit on e010 terminal status. Five episode clusters remain far too few for inference.

representation_observation: B has no observed material errors at the same substantive and information coverage as A, so this pilot still does not support an RQ1 advantage for structure over strong prose.
planning_family_observation: All conditions correctly report NO_VALID_PATH and withhold physical cause on the dedicated planning question. A/B also use this mechanism on terminal status; C/D/E use the generic terminal plan and lose one information unit.
next_design_action: Collect additional independent instances and a recovery-success mechanism, then obtain blind dual annotation before using development discordance and clustering for power simulation.
